validation.failureHandling: Repair UI/data normalization or audit wiring and rerun before release.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks release due to user-facing data-integrity risk.

validation.name: Tier 4 AI Helper approval/notification live proof

validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Visual rendering is proven by the subsequent populated authenticated click audit.
validation.failureHandling: Preserve run ID, repair provider/persistence/readback flow, rerun lane and lifecycle.
validation.ownerDecisionNeeded: NO unless credentials/provider access are unavailable.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks COMPLETE and populated audit because required test data was not proven.

validation.name: Container snapshot and screenshot fallback
validation.productionRisk: Browser-unavailable containers could falsely claim visual validation or skip UI/data contracts.

validation.whatItDoesNotProve: Live DOM rendering, browser navigation, CSS/layout, focus, overlap, responsive behavior, or newly captured screenshots.
validation.failureHandling: Repair source and rerun. Do not attempt repeated Chromium installation as the default response.
validation.blockerPolicy: Blocks artifact delivery if fallback fails; passing fallback still requires local browser validation.
